title: Why isn't your resume on your LinkedIn? ✍️
description:
LinkedIn now lets you upload your resume to your profile making it even easier for you to be found by recruiters. Being found for a job is all about having the right keywords on your profile so now that your resume counts in that bucket of content you can update your resume with those great keywords without constantly updating your LinkedIn profile if you’re job searching and you don’t want your employer to know. Use the Teal Job Tracker and Resume Builder to easily find and transfer keywords from the job description to your resume and upload! #linkedin  #linkedintips #linkedinprofile
